description: Adapted from Grafana dashboard 17626 revision 1 (https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/17626/) for Longhorn 1.13.

panels.description: The total number of volumes in the Longhorn storage system
panels.title: Total Number Of Volumes

panels.description: Healthy volumes are volumes that are attaching to a node and have the number of healthy replicas equals to the expected number of replicas.
panels.title: Number Of Healthy Volumes

panels.description: Degraded volumes are volumes that have the number of healthy replicas smaller than the expected number of replicas. e.g. User creates a volume with 2 replicas but 1 replicas is failed.
panels.title: Number Of Degraded Volumes

panels.description: Fault volumes are volumes that doesn't have any healthy replica.
panels.title: Number Of Faulted Volumes

panels.description: Degraded volumes are volumes that have the number of healthy replicas smaller than the expected number of replicas. e.g. User creates a volume with 2 replicas but 1 replicas is failed.
panels.title: Number Of Unknown Volumes

panels.description: Attached volumes are volumes that are currently attaching to a node
panels.title: Number Of Attached Volumes

panels.description: Detached volumes are volumes that aren't currently attaching to a node
panels.title: Number Of Detached Volumes

panels.description: Light green is filesystem usage; the full bar is that PVC's filesystem capacity. PVCs without kubelet filesystem metrics are omitted.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  (
100 * (
  max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes)
  / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes > 0)
)
and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
label_replace(
  label_replace(longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{pvc_namespace!="",pvc!=""}, "namespace", "$1", "pvc_namespace", "(.+)"),
  "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "pvc", "(.+)"
)
  ),
  "storage_column", "Used", "", ".*"
)

label_replace(
  (
max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes > 0)
and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
(100 * (
  max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes)
  / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes > 0)
)
and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)
label_replace(
  label_replace(longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{pvc_namespace!="",pvc!=""}, "namespace", "$1", "pvc_namespace", "(.+)"),
  "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "pvc", "(.+)"
)
)
  ),
  "storage_column", "Total Capacity", "", ".*"
)

panels.title: PVC Filesystem Usage

panels.description: Note that Longhorn volume actual size is not the size of the filesystem inside a Longhorn volume.  See more at : https://longhorn.io/docs/1.0.2/volumes-and-nodes/volume-size/#volume-actual-size
panels.title: Volume Actual Size/Capacity

panels.description: The total number of nodes in the Longhorn storage system
panels.title: Total Number Of Nodes

panels.description: Schedulable nodes are nodes that Longhorn can use their storage for replica scheduling.

targets.expr: (count(longhorn_node_status{condition="schedulable"}==1) OR on() vector(0)) - (count(longhorn_node_status{condition="allowScheduling"}==0) OR on() vector(0))

panels.title: Number Of Schedulable Nodes

panels.description: Disabled nodes are nodes that are disabled by the user.  When users disable a node, Longhorn will not use the node's storage for replica scheduling. Note that Longhorn can still attach a volume to disabled nodes because the actual data of the volume could be on a different node.
panels.title: Number Of Disabled Nodes

panels.description: Failed Nodes are nodes that Longhorn cannot attach volumes to and cannot schedule replicas onto. e.g: when the nodes went down.

targets.expr: (avg(longhorn_node_count_total) OR on() vector(0)) - (count(longhorn_node_status{condition="ready"}==1) OR on() vector(0))

panels.title: Number Of Failed Nodes

panels.description: Light green is storage used on the node's Longhorn disks; the full bar is their total storage capacity as reported by Longhorn.
panels.title: Node Storage Usage

panels.description: Light green is storage used on each Longhorn disk; the full bar is that disk's total storage capacity as reported by Longhorn.
panels.title: Disk Storage Usage

panels.description: The capacity of each Longhorn volume
panels.title: Disk Space Usage

panels.description: Current Longhorn volumes only. Completed Backups counts retained backups reported by Longhorn. A zero last-backup timestamp means no successful backup is recorded; a dash means the timestamp or age is unavailable.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  (
1000 * max by (volume, pvc_namespace, pvc) (longhorn_volume_last_backup_at{namespace="longhorn"})
and on (volume, pvc_namespace, pvc) max by (volume, pvc_namespace, pvc) (longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{namespace="longhorn"})
  ),
  "backup_column", "Last Successful Backup", "", ".*"
)

label_replace(
  (
(time() - (max by (volume, pvc_namespace, pvc) (longhorn_volume_last_backup_at{namespace="longhorn"}) > 0))
and on (volume, pvc_namespace, pvc) max by (volume, pvc_namespace, pvc) (longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{namespace="longhorn"})
  ),
  "backup_column", "Backup Age", "", ".*"
)

panels.title: Volume Backup Status

panels.description: CronJobs in the Longhorn namespace, with their configured schedule, timezone, and current job status.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  (
((2 * max by (cronjob) (kube_cronjob_spec_suspend{namespace="longhorn"})) + ((max by (cronjob) (kube_cronjob_status_active{namespace="longhorn"}) > bool 0) * (1 - max by (cronjob) (kube_cronjob_spec_suspend{namespace="longhorn"}))))
* on (cronjob) group_left (schedule, timezone)
max by (cronjob, schedule, timezone) (kube_cronjob_info{namespace="longhorn"})
  ),
  "backup_column", "Job Status", "", ".*"
)

panels.title: Recurring Backup Jobs
